name: start_calls
description: Call this only after the caller confirmed which listings to verify, or when they give a number to call as the listing agent (e.g. 4375550100). BEFORE calling it, ask if there is anything else they want asked on those calls. After it returns, read the speak field aloud. listing_ids are real ids from the last record_preferences shortlist (like L061), or the demo listing-agent number.

request_body_schema.description: Which shortlist listings to call, plus any extra questions for the listing agent.

properties.description: Use session_id from the last tool result. Omit on the first inbound call. Never invent it.
Real listing ids from the shortlist, comma-separated, e.g. L061, L003. Or the listing-agent number to dial, e.g. 4375550100.
Extra things the caller wants asked, comma-separated short phrases.
